criteria_verification.notes: Independent tests test_quote_straddling_chunk_boundary_defers_until_close and test_verifier_called_with_accumulated_not_chunk both PASSED. Implementation defers chunk release when quote count is odd and calls verifier with accumulated text, not isolated chunks.
Independent test test_previously_released_chunks_never_altered PASSED. Implementation uses last_released_pos marker to ensure previously released chunks are immutable.

Independent tests test_verifier_exception_raises_instead_of_yielding and test_partial_verifier_exception_stops_mid_stream both PASSED. Implementation raises RuntimeError instead of yielding when verifier_exception=True, enforcing fail-closed behavior per ASSUM-007.

Independent tests test_short_answer_yields_single_chunk, test_long_answer_breaks_at_sentence_boundaries, and test_chunk_size_approximately_fifteen_to_twenty_five_words all PASSED. Implementation detects sentence boundaries and enforces MIN_CHUNK_WORDS=15 threshold with final chunk handling for short answers.
Quality gates confirm all files pass ruff check and mypy type checking with zero errors. all_gates_passed=true in evidence bundle.
